+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command, role_count, collection_count, skipped_message', [
+    (['install'], 1, 1, None),
+    (['install', '-p', '/tmp/galaxy-roles'], 1, 0, 'Collections cannot be installed to a roles path'),
+    (['install', '--roles-path', '/tmp/galaxy-roles'], 1, 0, 'Collections cannot be installed to a roles path'),
+    (['role', 'install'], 1, 0, None),
+    (['role', 'install', '-p', '/tmp/galaxy-roles'], 1, 0, None),
+    (['collection', 'install'], 0, 1, 'contains roles which will be ignored'),
+])
+def test_mixed_requirements_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, command, role_count, collection_count,
+                                    skipped_message):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path.joinpath('requirements.yml'))
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- example.role\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+
+    mock_roles = MagicMock()
+    mock_collections = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', mock_roles)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', mock_collections)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+    assert mock_roles.call_count == role_count
+    assert mock_collections.call_count == collection_count
+    if role_count:
+        assert [role.name for role in mock_roles.call_args[0][0]] == ['example.role']
+    if collection_count:
+        assert mock_collections.call_args[0][0] == [('example.collection', '*', None)]
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr()
+    if skipped_message:
+        assert skipped_message in output.out + output.err
+    if role_count:
+        assert 'Starting galaxy role install process' in output.out
+
+

+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', MagicMock())
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'role', 'install', '-r', requirements_file]).run()

+
+    co.GlobalCLIArgs._Singleton__instance = None
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'role', 'install', '-vvv', '-r', requirements_file]).run()
+    assert 'contains collections which will be ignored' in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+

+        req_obj.write('roles: []\ncollections: []\n')
+
+    mock_roles = MagicMock()

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('child_installed, force_flag, expected', [

+def test_role_dependencies_only_reinstall_when_forced(monkeypatch, child_installed, force_flag, expected):
+    installed = []
+
+    class FakeRole(object):
+        def __init__(self, galaxy, api, name, src=None, version=None, scm=None, path=None):
+            self.name = name
+            self.src = src or name
+            self.scm = scm
+            self.version = version
+            self.path = path or 'unused'
+            dependencies = {
+                'example.root': ['example.child'],
+                'example.child': ['example.grandchild'],
+            }
+            self.metadata = {'dependencies': dependencies.get(name, [])}
+            self.requirements = []
+            self.install_info = {'version': version} if name == 'example.child' and child_installed else None
+
+        def __eq__(self, other):

+        def __repr__(self):
